items.title: Laboratorios Roemmers (Argentina) listed by Aurora
items.summary: The Aurora group posted Argentine pharmaceutical maker Laboratorios Roemmers SAICF to its leak site on Oct 1; the claim is unconfirmed by the company.

items.title: Dynamic Office Solutions (UK) claimed by Qilin
items.summary: Qilin added UK firm Dynamic Office Solutions to its leak site on Oct 1; no victim statement yet.

items.title: La Ponderosa (Mexico) claimed by Emperador
items.summary: The Emperador group listed Mexican company La Ponderosa on Oct 1, a day after posting SitePro Rentals; both claims are unverified.

items.title: The Japan Times listed by Eclipse
items.summary: English-language newspaper The Japan Times appeared on the Eclipse leak site on Sep 30; the publisher has not confirmed an incident.

items.title: Keio Corporation (Japan) confirms ransomware attack
items.summary: Japanese railway and services group Keio confirmed a ransomware attack on Sep 26 that disrupted payment and reservation systems.

items.title: Houston Thyroid & Endocrine Specialists claimed by N0n
items.summary: The N0n group listed the Texas endocrinology practice on Sep 30; the claim implies patient data exposure but is unverified.

items.title: France's CNEH hospital-expertise centre claimed by Kairos
items.summary: Kairos posted Le Centre National de l'Expertise Hospitalière, a French hospital-sector training and consulting body, to its leak site on Sep 30.

items.title: Play posts three victims in one day
items.summary: Play listed Titus (Germany), Airtech Mechanical Services (US) and Orth Automobile (Germany) on Sep 30, part of 16 leak-site postings across 12 groups that day.

ransomware.note: First day of October: items are Oct 1 and Sep 26-30. Leak-site listings are attacker claims, not victim confirmations.

items.title: Spotify global outage
items.summary: Spotify suffered a major outage on Sep 29 affecting more than 200,000 reporting users across 173 countries; service recovered with no public root cause.

items.title: Asia-Pacific subsea cable faults congest Tokyo-Singapore routes
items.summary: Multiple subsea cable faults from Sep 21, compounded by the Sep 4 Australia-Singapore Cable break, caused elevated latency and intermittent connectivity through Singapore, Hong Kong and Japan into early October.

items.title: EE mobile network disruption (UK)
items.summary: Hundreds of EE customers reported connectivity and online-service problems starting around 12:26 AM BST on Sep 30.

items.title: Zoom Phone: Polycom desk phones offline
items.summary: Polycom desk phones on Zoom Phone went offline on Sep 25, and Zoom was still listed as degraded on Oct 1.

items.title: Twilio SMS and voice delivery failures
items.summary: Twilio reported carrier-specific SMS and voice delivery failures across multiple countries and remained in a degraded state on Oct 1.

items.title: OpenAI and Cloudflare degraded
items.summary: OpenAI showed elevated API latency and ChatGPT page errors while Cloudflare was also flagged degraded on Oct 1; Grok had a separate user-reported outage the evening of Sep 30.

outage.note: No major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud outage found in the past two weeks; all three were reporting operational on Oct 1.

items.title: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway zero-days under active exploitation
items.summary: CISA's Sep 27 alert covers eight NetScaler flaws (CVE-2026-88771 to -88778), two of which are zero-days enabling remote code execution and are being exploited globally; CISA advises checking for compromise and preserving forensic evidence before patching.

items.title: Nine CVEs added to CISA KEV in the week ending Sep 30
items.summary: Additions span Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager, Apple, Microsoft SharePoint, MikroTik RouterOS, WordPress core, WSO2 and Adobe Commerce/Magento alongside the two Citrix zero-days.

items.title: Bitget hot-wallet theft of about $387.5M
items.summary: Crypto exchange Bitget confirmed unauthorized transfers from a hot wallet on Sep 24 totalling roughly US$387.5 million.

items.title: Times Mobility (Japan): 6.6 million accounts stolen
items.summary: Car-sharing operator Times Mobility disclosed on Sep 25 that data from 6.6 million accounts, including driver's licence information, was stolen.

items.title: Terrebonne Parish (Louisiana) takes systems offline
items.summary: Terrebonne Parish Consolidated Government took IT systems and its website offline on Sep 30 after a suspected data compromise.

items.title: London & Quadrant Housing Trust: 12,000 residents affected
items.summary: UK housing association L&Q reported on Sep 28 that email and webform access was compromised, affecting about 12,000 residents.

items.title: Swiss broadcaster SRG SSR employee data exfiltrated
items.summary: SRG SSR disclosed on Sep 28 that employee contact and organizational data dating from 2020 was exfiltrated.

items.title: Arizona Judicial Branch confirms PII copied
items.summary: The Arizona Judicial Branch said on Sep 25 that personally identifiable information was copied in an intrusion whose full extent is still under investigation.

items.title: Hurricane Polo strikes Baja California Sur and Sonora
items.summary: Polo peaked at Category 5, made landfall on Baja California Sur as a Category 2 on Sep 28 and came ashore again near Guaymas on Sep 29, bringing damaging winds, storm surge, flooding and mudslide risk.

items.title: Polo remnants raise flood risk in the US Southwest
items.summary: Polo's remnants combined with moisture from Post-Tropical Cyclone Odalys are forecast to move over the southwestern US and southern Plains, fueling heavy rain and flooding.

items.title: Hurricane Nolo soaks Hawaii
items.summary: Category 4 Nolo passed close to Hawaii in late September, dropping more than 12 inches of rain on Maui and Hawaii Island with flooded roads, downed trees and landslides.

items.title: Tropical Storm Rachel off southwest Mexico
items.summary: Rachel is tracking along Mexico's southwest coast with strong winds and dangerous surf.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake near Tadine, New Caledonia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.6 quake struck 80 km ENE of Tadine on Sep 25; no tsunami was generated and the USGS alert level was green.

items.title: M 4.2 earthquake near Wauna, Washington
items.summary: A magnitude 4.2 quake hit 6 km WNW of Wauna in the Puget Sound area on Sep 29; green alert, no tsunami.

physical.note: Northeast Pacific season is running at more than twice normal accumulated cyclone energy: 20 named storms and 9 hurricanes through Sep 28.
